title.en: Which Road the Caravans Actually Take

desc.zh: 先核对可用路线与真实瓶颈：现有领土与邻接、驿站的存废、重复征收的关票，再由提案国发出通行照会，主过境国与地方授权方各自作答。
desc.en: Verify the usable routes and the real bottlenecks first: held territory and adjacency, the state of the relay stations, the duplicated gate tolls; then the proposing court sends the transit note, and the main transit country and the local authorizer each answer for themselves.

title.en: Who Pays for the Relay Stations

desc.zh: 护路、驿站与仓储都要从当前国库实付：每个出资国择一先办，商团垫资或官办各立其册；牧道与商运相争、山口封闭时按已发生的事实处理。
desc.en: Road protection, relay stations and warehouses are all paid from the current treasury: each funding court picks one to begin with, and merchant advance or public office each keeps its own register; when herding trails clash with cart traffic or a pass closes, matters are settled by what has actually happened.

desc.zh: 复议与结算：多边约定限缩或照原案推进，关税方作最后一答，实际签字国按真实出资盖印；道路带来的客人按国别线如实记入，未成则保持季节交换。
desc.en: Review and settlement: the multilateral text is narrowed or carried forward, the tariff court gives its final answer, the actual signatories seal against what they truly paid; the guests the road brought are recorded against the country lines as they are, or the seasonal exchange continues.

title.en: The Station That Vanished from the Map

desc.zh: 册子上的驿站还在，路上的驿站已经塌了半边。提案国逐段核对现有领土与邻接：哪条线仍有完整驿站，哪段关票重复征收，哪处维护欠账最重；对照的结果决定提案先改何处。
desc.en: The register still lists the relay station; on the road, half of it has fallen in. The proposing court checks held territory and adjacency stretch by stretch: which line still has intact stations, which gate collects its toll twice, which maintenance debt runs deepest. The comparison decides where the proposal starts.

title.en: More Gate Passes than Pack Horses

desc.zh: 一段路上收了三道关票，护路的钱却一年未到。查税、护路与地方收入之后，提案国决定先改何处，再向过境方与关税方发出照会；对方已无有效当事者时，本案无从谈判。
desc.en: One stretch collects three gate tolls while the road-guard money has not arrived for a year. After the audit of tolls, protection and local revenue, the proposing court decides what to fix first and sends the note to the transit parties and the tariff holder. If the other side has no valid party left, there is nothing to negotiate.

title.en: The Treasury Cannot Repair Every Mountain Road

desc.zh: 护路、驿站、仓储三件事都在等钱，国库只够先办一件。各出资国检查国力后择一先办，付不起就缩减为养护一支；不出虚账，不留永久欠费。
desc.en: Road protection, relay stations and warehouses all wait for money, and the treasury funds only one first. Each funding court checks its own strength and picks one; those who cannot pay trim down to maintaining a single line. No false accounts are entered and no permanent debt is left.

title.en: The Fine Print of the Caravan Contract

desc.zh: 商团愿意先垫资修路，条件是把监督权写进细则；官府自己出钱，则保住公营的名分。两种承包各有各的账，日后追责时各按其册，垄断之弊另册检查。
desc.en: The merchant consortia will advance the repair money if the oversight right is written into the fine print; if the offices pay themselves, the public name is kept. Each form of contract keeps its own account, audited later against its own register, with the abuse of monopoly checked in a separate file.

title.en: The Herding Trail Yielded to the Cart Road

desc.en: The newly graded cart road cuts across the lambing-season herding trail, and the steppe party must give its local answer: compensate the seasonal migration, turn the caravans aside, or requisition the corridor outright. The price of requisition is that the upkeep promise loses its credit.

events.immediate: { if = { limit = { ywc_c03_mgl_delivery_1206 = yes } ywc_c03_receive_major = yes } }
